name: WildfireWhatIf
description: What-if wildfire scenario tool: draw a fire perimeter (HRRR region auto-derived with a 15 km buffer), the latest available HRRR wind loads automatically from Veloserver, tweak speed/direction, and submit fire spread or smoke dispersion forecasts.

components.name: WFIGS Layer Name
components.description: UUID of the WFIGS active fire perimeters layer (from the layer config). When the tool is open, clicking a feature on that layer draws the HRRR bbox around its centroid.

components.name: Veloserver URL
components.description: Veloserver origin or path serving HRRR gribjson winds. Default 'veloserver' uses MMGIS's built-in proxy (requires WITH_VELOSERVER=true). May be absolute, e.g. https://firepanel.ai/veloserver.
